group.label: Claude Connector
group.comment: Your store as a connector in Claude: the Claude app on a phone or computer uses the assistant's tools, commands and documentation with your Claude subscription, no API key. Add it in Claude as a custom connector with the URL https://your-store/mcp; the admin allows the connection in this admin (its own sign-in and two-step verification), and the connection has that admin user's role. System > Other Settings > Claude Connections lists and revokes them.

field.label: Access Token Lifetime (hours)
field.comment: Claude renews it on its own with the refresh token.

field.label: Connection Lifetime (days)
field.comment: After this the admin signs in again.

field.label: Registrations per Hour per Address
field.comment: How many times one address may register an OAuth client (Claude registers one per connection) within a clock hour; more get HTTP 429.

field.label: Link to the Admin on the Connect Page
field.comment: The page Claude opens asks the admin to allow the connection in this admin. With Yes it links here; anyone who opens that public page then sees the admin's address. With No the admin opens the admin themselves.

field.label: Notify of New Connections
field.comment: When an admin allows a connection: a message in the admin's notifications and an email with who, when and from where. A stolen admin password that connects Claude is seen at once.

field.label: Send the Email To
field.comment: Empty: the store's General Contact (Stores > Configuration > General > Store Email Addresses).

field.label: Confirm in the Admin
field.comment: Changes of these kinds wait in the admin (Claude Connections > Changes Waiting for You) and only the admin confirms them there; Claude cannot confirm them itself, even if something it reads tells it to. Other changes are confirmed in the conversation. An entry such as "update_product: price" covers only the changes that give that field. By default: orders' money, shipping and cancellations, emails to customers, deleting waybills, settings, fiscal receipts, and product price, special price and qty (also when scheduled). There is no refund tool.

field.label: Other Allowed Redirect URIs
field.comment: One per line, for MCP clients other than Claude (Claude's own and localhost callbacks are always allowed).
